title: Yellowed Garlicky Canadian Kale Skillet
description: A garlicky and juicy Canadian dish featuring kale, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This energizing skillet is filled with flavor and nutrients.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped kale to the skillet and cook until it starts to wilt.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Season the skillet with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the lemon juice and chicken broth into the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the skillet for 5 minutes.
Serve the skillet hot and enjoy.
